title: Terminate a resumed uncontained native root when its supervisor drops on an error
outcome: Terminate a resumed uncontained native root when its supervisor drops on an error
acceptance: A forced-unavailable, resumed-root regression retains process identity and establishes root termination before fixture cleanup; normal completed launches and contained lease teardown remain correct.
An unavailable native launch that is dropped after resume on an error path attempts termination of its retained root handle without claiming descendant containment.
